20261119-physics-h2.goal: Apply principles of An sanya abu A mai nauyin to solve the reasoning problem.
20261119-physics-h2.material: An sanya abu A mai nauyin kilogiram 3 da abu B mai nauyin kilogiram 2 suna taɓa juna a kan fili a kwance mara gogayya, kuma an yi amfani da ƙarfin newton 20 a kwance don tura ta gefen A. Nawa ne hanzarin abubuwan biyu da girman ƙarfin da A ke turawa B da shi, bi da bi?
20261119-physics-h2.thinking.0: An sanya abu A mai nauyin
20261119-physics-h2.s.s1.prompt: An sanya abu A mai nauyin kilogiram 3 da abu B mai nauyin kilogiram 2 suna taɓa juna a kan fili a kwance mara gogayya, kuma an yi amfani da ƙarfin newton 20 a kwance don tura ta gefen A. Nawa ne hanzarin abubuwan biyu da girman ƙarfin da A ke turawa B da shi, bi da bi?

Ƙarfin gaba ɗaya kaɗai da ke hanzarta abu B shi ne ƙarfin taɓawa da A ke turawa B da shi, don haka $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.

20261121-physics-h2-2.material: Belun kunne masu kawar da hayaniya (noise canceling) suna auna hayaniyar waje da makirufo, sa'an nan su fitar ta lasifika da igiyar sauti da ke (   ) dangane da wannan hayaniya, don soke ta. Wace siffar igiya ce ta cike gurbin?
20261121-physics-h2-2.thinking.0: Belun kunne masu kawar da hayaniya
20261121-physics-h2-2.s.s1.prompt: Belun kunne masu kawar da hayaniya (noise canceling) suna auna hayaniyar waje da makirufo, sa'an nan su fitar ta lasifika da igiyar sauti da ke (   ) dangane da wannan hayaniya, don soke ta. Wace siffar igiya ce ta cike gurbin?
20261121-physics-h2-2.s.s1.explain: Noise canceling yana samar da igiyar sauti ta wucin gadi mai girman girgiza iri ɗaya da igiyar hayaniyar waje kuma lokaci akasin haka da $180^\circ$ (antiphase), yana haddasa soke juna ta haɗuwa kuma yana kawar da hayaniya.

20261122-physics-h2-1.title: Idan aka kawo maganaɗisu kusa da
20261122-physics-h2-1.topic: Idan aka kawo maganaɗisu kusa da
20261122-physics-h2-1.goal: Apply principles of Idan aka kawo maganaɗisu kusa da to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-h2-1.material: [Zurfafa induction na lantarki-maganaɗisu] Idan aka kawo maganaɗisu kusa da coil, ƙarfin lantarki da aka jawo (induced emf) yana bayyana (dokar Faraday da dokar Lenz). Wutar da aka jawo tana gudana a hanyar da take 'hana' canjin magnetic flux ta cikin coil. Menene dalilin kimiyyar lissafi na wannan, don cika kiyayewar menene?
20261122-physics-h2-1.thinking.0: Idan aka kawo maganaɗisu kusa da
20261122-physics-h2-1.s.s1.prompt: [Zurfafa induction na lantarki-maganaɗisu] Idan aka kawo maganaɗisu kusa da coil, ƙarfin lantarki da aka jawo (induced emf) yana bayyana (dokar Faraday da dokar Lenz). Wutar da aka jawo tana gudana a hanyar da take 'hana' canjin magnetic flux ta cikin coil. Menene dalilin kimiyyar lissafi na wannan, don cika kiyayewar menene?
20261122-physics-h2-1.s.s1.explain: A dokar Lenz, cewa ƙarfin lantarki da aka jawo yana samuwa a hanyar da take hana canjin flux wani sakamako ne na tilas na dokar kiyayewar kuzari. Idan ya taimaka wa canjin, za a sami injin motsi na har abada, inda kuzari ke ƙaruwa da kansa ba tare da aikin ƙarfin waje ba.
20261122-physics-h2-1.s.s1.hint.0: Idan wutar ta gudana a hanyar da take ƙara jawo maganaɗisu yayin da yake kusantowa, za a sami sabani: kuzari zai ci gaba da samuwa har abada ko da an bar shi.
20261122-physics-h2-1.s.s1.hint.1: Ita ce babbar ka'idar yanayi, dokar kiyayewar kuzari.

20261122-physics-h2-2.material: A sadarwar fiber-optic ta intanet mai gudu sosai, haske yana yaduwa nesa a cikin tsakiyar fiber ba tare da asara ba saboda 'cikakken mayar da haske daga ciki (total internal reflection)'. Wane ne daidaitaccen sharaɗin da cikakken mayar da haske daga ciki ke faruwa?
20261122-physics-h2-2.thinking.0: A sadarwar fiber-optic ta intanet mai
20261122-physics-h2-2.s.s1.prompt: A sadarwar fiber-optic ta intanet mai gudu sosai, haske yana yaduwa nesa a cikin tsakiyar fiber ba tare da asara ba saboda 'cikakken mayar da haske daga ciki (total internal reflection)'. Wane ne daidaitaccen sharaɗin da cikakken mayar da haske daga ciki ke faruwa?
20261122-physics-h2-2.s.s1.explain: Cikakken mayar da haske daga ciki shi ne al'amarin da, idan haske ya yi tafiya daga matsakaici mai babban refractive index zuwa mai ƙarami, kuma kusurwar shigowa ta fi kusurwar muhimmi girma, ba a samun igiyar karkatawa a iyaka kuma ana mayar da haske $100\%$.
20261122-physics-h2-2.s.s1.hint.0: Haske yana karkata idan ya fito daga tsakiya mai yawa (babban refractive index) zuwa cladding mara yawa.
20261122-physics-h2-2.s.s1.hint.1: Idan ya wuce kusurwar muhimmi, ba ya karkata kuma ana mayar da shi 100%.
20261122-physics-h2-2.s.s1.o.o0: Haske yana shigowa daga matsakaici mai babban refractive index (matsakaici mai yawa) zuwa mai ƙaramin refractive index (matsakaici mara yawa), kuma kusurwar shigowa ta fi kusurwar muhimmi (critical angle) girma

20261118-physics-h3.goal: Apply principles of Wane sakamako ne na gwajin photoelectric to solve the reasoning problem.
20261118-physics-h3.material: Wane sakamako ne na gwajin photoelectric effect na Einstein da 'ka'idar igiyar haske' ba za ta iya bayyana shi ba kwata-kwata, kuma 'ka'idar photon (barbashi) ta haske' kaɗai ce ke bayyana shi cikakke?
20261118-physics-h3.thinking.0: Wane sakamako ne na gwajin photoelectric
20261118-physics-h3.s.s1.prompt: Wane sakamako ne na gwajin photoelectric effect na Einstein da 'ka'idar igiyar haske' ba za ta iya bayyana shi ba kwata-kwata, kuma 'ka'idar photon (barbashi) ta haske' kaɗai ce ke bayyana shi cikakke?
20261118-physics-h3.s.s1.explain: Ka'idar igiya tana hasashen cewa kuzari yana taruwa a kan lokaci, amma a photoelectric effect photon ɗaya sama da mitar ƙofa yana yin karo da electron nan take ya miƙa masa kuzarinsa, don haka ana fitar da electron nan take ba tare da jinkirin lokaci ba.
20261118-physics-h3.s.s1.hint.0: A bisa ka'idar igiya, ko da rauni haske idan aka haska shi na dogon lokaci ya kamata kuzari ya taru kuma a fitar da electrons, amma a gaskiya ana fitarwa nan take.

20261119-physics-h3.material: Wani barbashi mai caji mai yawa m da caji q yana shigowa a tsaye (perpendicular) cikin filin maganaɗisu B mai daidaito da gudun v kuma yana yin motsin zagaye tsayayye. Wane zaɓi ne ya bayyana daidai radius r da period T na hanyar zagayensa?
20261119-physics-h3.thinking.0: Wani barbashi mai caji mai yawa
20261119-physics-h3.s.s1.prompt: Wani barbashi mai caji mai yawa m da caji q yana shigowa a tsaye (perpendicular) cikin filin maganaɗisu B mai daidaito da gudun v kuma yana yin motsin zagaye tsayayye. Wane zaɓi ne ya bayyana daidai radius r da period T na hanyar zagayensa?
20261119-physics-h3.s.s1.explain: Daga lissafin ƙarfin tsakiya, $\frac{mv^2}{r} = qvB \implies r = \frac{mv}{qB}$. Period shi ne $T = \frac{2\pi r}{v} = \frac{2\pi m}{qB}$, kuma abin mamaki, wannan cyclotron period ba ya dogara da radius na hanya ko gudu.

20261121-physics-h3-1.goal: Apply principles of A samfurin Bohr na atom ɗin to solve the reasoning problem.
20261121-physics-h3-1.material: A samfurin Bohr na atom ɗin hydrogen, wane ne daidaitaccen sharaɗin igiya tsayayye tsakanin tsawon igiyar abu (matter wave) λ na electron da ke zagaya hanyar da ke da lambar quantum ta farko n da radius r na hanyar?
20261121-physics-h3-1.thinking.0: A samfurin Bohr na atom ɗin
20261121-physics-h3-1.s.s1.prompt: A samfurin Bohr na atom ɗin hydrogen, wane ne daidaitaccen sharaɗin igiya tsayayye tsakanin tsawon igiyar abu (matter wave) λ na electron da ke zagaya hanyar da ke da lambar quantum ta farko n da radius r na hanyar?
20261121-physics-h3-1.s.s1.explain: Bisa hasashen igiyar abu na de Broglie, idan tsawon kewayen hanya $2\pi r$ ya zama cikakken adadi na tsawon igiyar abu $\lambda$ ($2\pi r = n\lambda$), ana samar da igiya tsayayye kuma hanyar electron tana kasancewa karɓaɓɓiya.
20261121-physics-h3-1.s.s1.hint.0: Dole kewayen hanyar electron ya zama daidai da cikakken adadi na tsawon igiyar de Broglie don a samar da igiya tsayayye ta ƙarfafawa ta haɗuwa.

20261121-physics-h3-2.thinking.0: Menene muhimmin dalilin kimiyyar lissafi da

20261121-physics-h3-2.s.s1.explain: Resolution na na'urar hangen nesa yana ƙaruwa yayin da tsawon igiyar da ake amfani da ita ke ƙara ƙanƙanta, saboda ƙarancin diffraction. 20261122-physics-h3-1.title: Matsakaicin nisan a kwance R na

20261122-physics-h3-1.goal: Apply principles of Matsakaicin nisan a kwance R na to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-h3-1.material: [Zurfafa injiniyanci mai girma biyu] Matsakaicin nisan a kwance R na wani abu da aka harba daga ƙasa da kusurwa θ da a kwance da saurin farko v₀ shi ne R = (v₀² sin 2θ) / g. Idan babu juriyar iska, wace kusurwar harbawa θ ce nisan a kwance yake mafi girma, kuma wace ce wata kusurwar harbawa da ke da nisan a kwance iri ɗaya da kusurwar harbawa ta 30°, bi da bi?
20261122-physics-h3-1.thinking.0: Matsakaicin nisan a kwance R na
20261122-physics-h3-1.s.s1.prompt: [Zurfafa injiniyanci mai girma biyu] Matsakaicin nisan a kwance R na wani abu da aka harba daga ƙasa da kusurwa θ da a kwance da saurin farko v₀ shi ne R = (v₀² sin 2θ) / g. Idan babu juriyar iska, wace kusurwar harbawa θ ce nisan a kwance yake mafi girma, kuma wace ce wata kusurwar harbawa da ke da nisan a kwance iri ɗaya da kusurwar harbawa ta 30°, bi da bi?
20261122-physics-h3-1.s.s1.explain: Sharaɗin da $\sin 2\theta$ ya zama mafi girma shi ne $2\theta = 90^\circ \implies \theta = 45^\circ$. Bugu da ƙari, tun da $\sin(2 \times 30^\circ) = \sin 60^\circ = \sin 120^\circ = \sin(2 \times 60^\circ)$, nisan yana daidai a kusurwar ($60^\circ$) da jimillarta ke $90^\circ$.

20261122-physics-h3-2.s.s1.explain: Laser haske ne da aka samar ta stimulated emission; tsawon igiyar dukan photons da aka fitar ya daidaita sosai (launi ɗaya) kuma lokacin igiya ya daidaita gaba ɗaya (coherent), don haka yana da kyakkyawan tafiya tsaye da iya taruwa waje ɗaya.
